camera_position_or_scene_hint: Player eye level at world entry; include Main Camera, Player start, Route_Anchor direction.
visual_requirement: Bright readable ocean/coast/sky/Aegir first frame; HUD/instruments legible; no dark cover.
gameplay_requirement: Player can identify first route direction and survival instrument state without debug map.
performance_requirement: Console clean for current session; GCMonitor visible or profiler GC Alloc ready; no scene-search/generated-content warnings.
pass_gate: Surface/coast/Aegir/route cue visible and HUD readable at Compact and Middle at minimum.
fail_gate: Empty beauty shot, black/muddy surface, UI overlap, or route cue absent.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Above-water view toward Aegir, moons/clouds, coast silhouette, ocean specular.
visual_requirement: Aegir/cloud/moon texture and horizon softness read premium; no sine-stripe/gradient placeholder.
gameplay_requirement: Horizon contains route or threat/engineering cue, not detached wallpaper.
performance_requirement: Frame Debugger later names active sky/material passes; profiler cost recorded if sky path changed.
capture_type: GameView screenshot and Frame Debugger note
pass_gate: Aegir, sky, coast, ocean surface, and one route/evidence cue are readable.
fail_gate: Disabled/inactive sky object treated as proof, muddy Aegir, one-note purple/blue gradient, or no route cue.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Low waterline angle at shore/coast; include foam ribbon, wet basalt, ocean surface, underwater edge.
visual_requirement: Water color, wave normals, specular, foam, refraction hint, and wet material edge meet surface floor.
gameplay_requirement: Player can read entry/exit line and return landmark from waterline.
performance_requirement: Frame Debugger proves water material/pass; profiler/GC proof exists for any water/foam feature; no blind Crest camera enable.
capture_type: GameView screenshot plus Frame Debugger snapshot
pass_gate: Premium waterline with readable entry and material identity, measured pass/cost evidence if modified.
fail_gate: Broad flat blue water, flat-color foam, hidden edge, or unmeasured expensive water path.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Close coast rock view with wet/dry transition, foam contact, sediment, silhouette.
visual_requirement: Wet basalt has strata/detail/mask response; no grey procedural blockout.
gameplay_requirement: Coast works as return landmark and route context, not decorative island only.
performance_requirement: Batches/SetPass/VRAM noted if coastline dressing changes; no runtime hero generation.
capture_type: GameView screenshot and optional SceneView material inspection
pass_gate: Coast material, foam edge, and route silhouette hold at Compact and improve at High.
fail_gate: Smooth noise terrain, grey blockout, no wetness, or excessive dressing with no metrics.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Underwater 5-20 m entry toward Starter_ReefField and return cue.
visual_requirement: Bright colorful shallows, coral/kelp/biota density, caustic hints, sediment, readable water optics.
gameplay_requirement: Player can see route corridor, oxygen state, and return direction while exploring.
performance_requirement: Profiler/GC proof for scatter/optics if changed; no random always-on particles or runtime hero mesh generation.
capture_type: GameView screenshot plus profiler marker list if changed
pass_gate: Shallows look authored, alive, and route-readable with Compact preserving beauty.
fail_gate: Empty rock field, aquarium blandness, over-fog, random scatter, or hidden return path.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Route_Frontier or deeper photic lane, route-facing and return-facing views.
visual_requirement: Water remains readable, twilight only where justified; instruments and silhouettes survive.
gameplay_requirement: Player can continue or retreat based on route/oxygen/pressure cues.
performance_requirement: Water optics/render features need profiler/GC/Frame Debugger proof; no fog cover.
pass_gate: Forward and return views both readable; route cue survives without debug map.
fail_gate: Fog/darkness hides route, instruments unreadable, or ultra-only readability.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Dock/sub/turbine/wreck service trace from route distance and close distance.
visual_requirement: Trace reads as machinery/history with wet/aged materials, not primitive decoration.
gameplay_requirement: Player understands this trace as evidence, route landmark, salvage risk, or machine verb.
performance_requirement: Batches/SetPass/profiler noted if kitbash/dressing changes; no third-party asset mutation.
pass_gate: Industrial trace sharpens route/evidence and has premium material identity.
fail_gate: Primitive boxes/tubes as final, clean sci-fi plastic, or machinery with no decision value.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Node_Copper_A approach from player route with geology/context and return cue.
visual_requirement: Resource reads physically credible; no abstract sparkle or colored currency.
gameplay_requirement: Player can identify and interact or scan/collect according to available tool route.
performance_requirement: Interaction path must show no GC allocation in hot path if exercised; profiler screenshot required for acceptance.
capture_type: GameView screenshot plus Play Mode interaction note
pass_gate: Resource is visible, contextual, interactable if feature exists, and tied to route choice.
fail_gate: UI-only target, random dot, hidden by fog, or static path claimed as interaction proof.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Scrap_A from route distance and close salvage view.
visual_requirement: Scrap reads as physical salvage with material wear and scale; no primitive/loot sparkle.
gameplay_requirement: Player can recover or evaluate it under oxygen/return pressure where implemented.
performance_requirement: Interaction/scan/pickup proof needs profiler/GC evidence; no runtime debris simulation without proof.
capture_type: GameView screenshot plus Play Mode interaction note
pass_gate: Scrap has physical identity, route cost, and readable recovery state.
fail_gate: Primitive prop, free loot, no route cost, or interaction claim without Play Mode artifact.

visual_requirement: Station reads as pressure-rated machine with labels/lights/pipes/material wear.
gameplay_requirement: Player can understand fabrication/repair/build role and route anchor purpose.
performance_requirement: Fabricator UI/interaction must prove no hot-path string/GC allocations if exercised.
capture_type: GameView screenshot plus Play Mode interaction note
pass_gate: Fabricator is physical, readable, usable if implemented, and not menu-only.
fail_gate: Flat UI menu, clean sci-fi prop, primitive construction asset as hero, or no interaction proof.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Return-facing sequence from resource/scrap/fabricator back to Route_Anchor/coast.
visual_requirement: World landmarks, foam/coast silhouettes, industrial trace, and instruments guide return.
gameplay_requirement: Player can retreat before oxygen failure without omniscient debug map.
performance_requirement: HUD/sonar assistance must be legible and 0-GC if active; no high-tier-only route cue.
capture_type: Screenshot sequence or short video frame set
pass_gate: Return path readable in world first, instruments second; Compact remains intentional.
fail_gate: Debug-map dependency, random maze confusion, dark-cover surface, or ultra-only readability.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Water entry plus timed swim until oxygen warning state appears, if survival route is active.
visual_requirement: Oxygen/pressure UI is readable on visor/HUD without clipping or hiding art.
gameplay_requirement: Player sees oxygen reserve, risk escalation, and retreat decision; no generic hidden drain.
performance_requirement: GC Alloc column/GCMonitor proves HUD warning path is 0 B/frame during 300-frame sample.
capture_type: Play Mode repro plus profiler/GC screenshot
pass_gate: Oxygen warning changes decision and remains readable under stress.
fail_gate: No oxygen display, unreadable warning, fatal surprise without evidence, or HUD string allocation.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Approach first route hazard or aggressive creature/pressure/weather cue where implemented.
visual_requirement: Hazard telegraphs through sound/visual/instrument/evidence; not cheap scare or invisible damage.
gameplay_requirement: Player can retreat, avoid, or respond; death possible only with readable cause.
performance_requirement: Profiler/GC stable during hazard; black-box or telemetry fields identified if critical.
capture_type: Play Mode repro plus screenshot/video frame
pass_gate: Hazard sharpens decision and leaves evidence; Compact preserves telegraph.
fail_gate: Random damage, no counterplay, no evidence, or report claims behavior from static object names.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: If death is reachable in route, record death cause, respawn anchor, resource drop/core tool state.
visual_requirement: Death/respawn presentation is readable and not clean reset fantasy.
gameplay_requirement: Cause is explainable; resources drop where relevant; core tools persist unless authored exception.
performance_requirement: Black-box dump or telemetry/log path required for fatal state; no fake death proof from docs.
capture_type: Play Mode repro plus log/telemetry artifact
pass_gate: Death teaches physical cause and returns player to safe anchor with policy visible.
fail_gate: Unexplained death loop, lost core tools without authored exception, or no telemetry/log proof.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Same camera for surface, waterline, and photic entry across quality weights/profiles.
visual_requirement: Compact remains beautiful/readable; Middle adds density; High/Ultra add sensory richness only.
gameplay_requirement: Gameplay truth, resource identity, route ownership, save identity, and interaction rules do not change by tier.
performance_requirement: Profiler/memory/VRAM deltas recorded per tier; no binary quality switch accepted.
capture_type: Comparison screenshot set plus profiler summary
pass_gate: Continuous quality scaling with no ugly compact mode and no gameplay truth change.
fail_gate: Compact/Ultra binary split, compact ugly mode, tier-only readability, or quality changing gameplay truth.

camera_position_or_scene_hint: Same route segment as screenshots: spawn to surface to waterline to shallow resource/fabricator loop.
visual_requirement: Visual claims tied to exact active material/render passes and screenshots.
gameplay_requirement: Gameplay claims tied to same repro path, not separate static notes.
performance_requirement: Unity Profiler, GC Alloc/GCMonitor, Frame Debugger, Memory/VRAM, batches, SetPass, frame time, and no hidden hot-path generation captured.
pass_gate: Artifact paths prove frame time, GC, memory/VRAM, material/pass state, and route repro together.
fail_gate: Fake numbers, no artifact path, old 1428 proof used as current proof, or metrics from a different scene/repro.
